name: Telegram
description: Telegram Bot integration for ActonOS AI agents with MarkdownV2, multi-bot accounts, and agent routing
author: ActonOS

poll_interval_seconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Delay in seconds between Telegram getUpdates polling cycles

accounts.title: Bot Accounts
accounts.description: Configure one or multiple Telegram bot instances

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Unique identifier for this bot instance used for routing and session isolation

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Friendly label for this bot account

bot_token.title: Telegram Bot Token
bot_token.description: Bot Token from @BotFather (securely stored in Hardware Vault)

default_agent.title: Default Target Agent
default_agent.description: Default ActonOS agent to dispatch incoming messages when no explicit @mention is present

listen_target.title: Listen Chat ID
listen_target.description: Optional Telegram chat ID to restrict polling (leave empty to receive all chats)

enable_typing_indicator.title: Live Typing Indicator
enable_typing_indicator.description: Broadcast sendChatAction(typing) while the agent generates a reply

enable_ack_reaction.title: Acknowledge with Reaction
enable_ack_reaction.description: React to the user's message via setMessageReaction to acknowledge receipt

parse_mode.title: Parse Mode
parse_mode.description: Rich text parser for outbound messages
